name: taglore-monorepo
description: Taglore: AI-written release notes from git tags, published to GitHub Releases, Docker builds, S3 and an in-app What's New dialog.

scripts.build: npm run build -w taglore && npm run build -w @taglore/whats-new && npm run bundle && npm run schema
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w taglore && npm run typecheck -w @taglore/whats-new
scripts.check-dist: npm run bundle && npm run schema && git diff --exit-code -- dist schema
